pages.title: Field Requisition
pages.text: $(bold)ORSA Supply Requisition Form: 200 pairs snowshoes, URGENT.$()$(br2)Addendum: whoever requisitioned 200 pairs of snow skis instead has been reassigned to Xenobiology.$(br2)Snowshoes keep you moving over shallow drifts and let you cross powder snow without sinking like a rookie.

pages.title: Use Notes
pages.text: While worn in a Curios $(thing)feet$() slot, snow layers give a noticeable speed boost that scales with depth. Ice stays just as slippery and snow blocks do not get any special handling.$(br2)Cheap to make, permanent to keep, and somehow still not standard issue.
Leather, sticks, string, and at least one person in the room who has seen winter before.
